Fixes.Detail: Debug delegate creation isolated in a helper reached only when DebugMode is enabled; live deferred IconId text semantics retained.

Revision/snapshot/culture/query/tab/spoiler/repeatable-aware quest groups, current MSQ, lazy accepted-first summary index, stable row IDs, level/start/requirements/reward text. Row submission, ImGui IDs, scrolling and focus paths retained.

Fixes.Reason: No row virtualization: ImGui submissions are retained to preserve keyboard navigation/focus and scroll extent.

Fixes.Detail: Per-layout section/group catalogue, search matches, reusable visible/primary/advanced lists and IDs. Visibility is evaluated per section and enabled state per group at their original points, preserving same-frame config/style/reset effects.
Item sections/title/stack cached by immutable item identity, culture and count inputs; summary strings cached with quest presentation. Inventory reads and action-time checks remain live.
Coordinate strings cached by exact float bits (including signed zero); clock text by displayed minute; digit string objects reused. Glyph measurements, hit rectangles and input remain per frame.

Fixes.Reason: No proven live font/atlas generation invalidation contract for cached wrapped metrics or digit widths; continue measuring current fonts.

Fixes.Detail: Early return only without retired workers, pending work/transitions or eviction. Reusable retired/sorted buffers and direct bounded scans preserve upload/failure handling, stable most-recent-first ordering, eviction, worker limit and transition cadence.

Fixes.Reason: Closed-map refresh maintains history, current objectives and first-open data. Pausing it could change first-open content; no behaviour-preserving inactive gate proven. Existing throttles remain.

Fixes.Detail: Refresh returns only when ineligible, previously ineligible, debug disabled, no shifted addon, mirroring, fade, close ownership or opened map. Missing-map counter still resets. Eligibility transitions, restoration and fades retain their original paths.
Duplicate/distance-aware names cached by result-array identity and culture, including outgoing animation snapshots. Existing naming function is reused unchanged.
